text:
Michael Amadio has become the Senators' quiet contract story. TSN's Mike Johnson said on Nov. 16 that Amadio will cash in on his next deal, and SenShot argued the same week that it's about time he got the recognition. The case on the ice: 7 goals and 13 points in 23 games on about 16 minutes, all of it at even strength (zero power-play points), with four goals in his last ten.

The finishing is running hot. Seven goals on about five expected is a shooting rate our talent range doesn't believe will last, so expect the goal pace to cool. What should hold is the rest: he's 53rd in the league in wins added by goals this season, and Evolving-Hockey had him worth 1.7 wins last year, 93rd percentile at taking chances away. They also noted he played with strong teammates, which flatters raw numbers.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 57% of his shots come off the rush, so he's most dangerous right after a turnover. Watch his ice time, up almost two minutes over the last ten games: it says Travis Green agrees with TSN.
